# CANDIDATE: TRENDLINE_BREAKOUT_VETO

**Filed:** 2026-07-03
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger_branch
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The TRENDLINE_BREAKOUT_VETO hypothesis proposes that a trendline breakout on the 5m chart, when combined with a bullish or bearish EMA ribbon flip, can be used as a high-confidence setup for entering a trade in the direction of the breakout.

## Mechanism

The TRENDLINE_BREAKOUT_VETO setup will be triggered when the following conditions are met:
- A trendline breakout occurs on the 5m chart.
- The EMA ribbon flips in the direction of the breakout (bullish for a long setup, bearish for a short setup).
- The setup is confirmed by a confluence of multi-day or premarket structure.
